trusted_external_entities.name: Calling Smart Contract
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Smart contract invoking secp256r1 precompile via CALL/STATICCALL. May provide malformed input data. All 160 bytes must be validated before cryptographic operations.

trusted_external_entities.name: WebAuthn/FIDO2 Device
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Hardware security module generating secp256r1 signatures (Apple Secure Enclave, Android Keystore, FIDO2). Device is trusted for key protection, but signature data still requires full validation before use.

trusted_external_entities.name: Key Provider
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External source providing keys for trie operations (addresses, storage slots). Keys must be hashed via keccak256 for secured tries to prevent key grinding attacks.

trusted_external_entities.name: Calling Contract (BN128)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Smart contract invoking BN128 add/mul precompiles. Input points must be validated as on-curve and within field bounds before computation.

trusted_external_entities.name: ZK Proof Verifier Contract
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Contract verifying zero-knowledge proofs using pairing checks. Input G1/G2 points must be validated for curve membership and subgroup order.

trusted_external_entities.name: Untrusted Caller Input
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Raw bytes from potentially malicious caller to BN128 precompiles. Requires full validation: length check, field modulus bounds, curve equation, subgroup order.

trusted_external_entities.name: Transaction Sender
trusted_external_entities.rationale: EOA or contract that submitted the transaction. Receipt status reflects execution outcome but sender has no control over status code assignment.

trusted_external_entities.name: RPC Client (Receipts)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: External application querying transaction receipts via JSON-RPC. Client must correctly interpret status code (0=failure, 1=success).

trusted_external_entities.name: Block Producer (Miner)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Ethereum miner constructing new blocks. Authenticated via proof-of-work, difficulty calculation follows consensus rules, but miner could attempt timestamp manipulation.

trusted_external_entities.name: Network Peer (Arrow Glacier)
trusted_external_entities.rationale: P2P network peer propagating new blocks. Block headers must be validated against Arrow Glacier difficulty rules.

trusted_external_entities.name: Peer Block Source
trusted_external_entities.rationale: Network peer that sent block for validation. Block difficulty must be verified against computed expected difficulty using Arrow Glacier formula.

boundary_edges.security_assumption: Input must be exactly 160 bytes with valid h, r, s, qx, qy. Signature bounds (0 < r,s < n), public key bounds (0 <= qx,qy < p), curve equation, and point-at-infinity checks required.
Device-generated signatures require full validation despite hardware trust. Format and cryptographic boundary checks must pass. Gas consumed even on failure.
Keys must be keccak256 hashed for secured tries to prevent key grinding attacks. Unsecured tries only for internal use.
Both G1 points must be validated on BN128 curve (y^2 = x^3 + 3). Coordinates must be < field modulus. Invalid points raise OutOfGasError.
Input length must be divisible by 192. Each G1 point (64 bytes) and G2 point (128 bytes) validated for curve membership and subgroup order.

data_flows_across: Raw input bytes for BN128 operations
boundary_edges.security_assumption: Complete validation chain: length check, coordinate extraction, field modulus bounds, curve equation verification, subgroup order check.
Status code determined by execution outcome (1=success, 0=revert). Block producer must correctly record status based on actual execution.
Receipt data includes authoritative status code. Client must correctly interpret status field position in post-Byzantium format.
Difficulty calculation uses Arrow Glacier offset (10,700,000). Miner must compute correct difficulty; validators will reject mismatched values.
Fork activation at block 13,773,000. Blocks at/after fork must use Arrow Glacier difficulty rules; validation rejects incorrect difficulty.
Claimed difficulty must match computed expected difficulty. Mismatch causes block rejection.
